declared_by: declaring and the governing run are research; building a file under runs/submissions and any upload stay the user's word
status: DECLARED before any published-data layer was run on the current model part's development predictions. Seen before declaring: the table's model-part RMSEs (docs/dev_model_part/README.md: v46 -> v55m January 322.86 -> 322.55, July 257.72 -> 257.41, November 184.91 -> 184.65, December 167.51 -> 167.07).
question: The three published-data steps (v48's reconciliation, the extreme-day layer, v57's variance re-allocation) were fitted on the v46-era development stack's residuals and are applied to the shipped model part v55m. Does refitting them on v55m's own development residuals do better?

procedure.tables: runs/daily_totals/rows.parquet with stack := v55m, the implied off-block day (take-off minus the prediction), the published totals joined on it and 'complete' recomputed exactly as tools/screen_daily_totals.py builds the table (session scratch refit_prep.py)
procedure.control: for scored month m: the fitting months keep the v46 stack (the shipped parameters' footing), month m is v55m; v48's declared procedure (configs/daily_totals_v1.json settings) for month m, then the extreme-day layer and v57's layer exactly as tools/scout_var_alloc.py layered(), fitted on the other months of that table
procedure.candidate: every month v55m; the same three steps fitted on the other months of that table
procedure.code: session scratch refit_prep.py, refit_run.py; tools/run_daily_totals.py run_month, tools/scout_var_alloc.py layered (unchanged)
procedure.free_parameters: none new; every parameter is refitted by the existing procedures

rule.text: accepted when (1) no development month is worse than the control by more than 0.005% of its RMSE (all rows); (2) the mean change over the equal-footing months is at least 0.02% below zero; (3) every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval (by off-block day, seed 20260929) lies below zero. November is reported in (1).

limitations.selection_inherited: the member layers inside v55m were selected on these same development months (v51 / v52 on January / July / December, v53 / v54 on January 2025, v55 on July / November / December), so a refit on v55m's residuals inherits that selection
limitations.no_twelve_month_check: the twelve-month table carries no v55m members, so it cannot test this refit; the development months are the only evidence, and the rule is the dense-layer rule of v48 accordingly
limitations.nesting: v55m's development values are out-of-sample for their own month but the fitting months' values came from models that saw the scored month (the frozen out-of-fold footing of every development read)

also_reported: v55m alone, the control and the candidate per month, so the shipped chain's own gain on v55m is on record
export: only if accepted and on the user's word: a ranking export path for refitted parameters does not exist yet and would be written then
